title: config/pipeline.yaml — this install's identity, paths, thresholds, pack selection

pack.description: Active pack name under packs/ (default: product).

name.description: Candidate full name — audit.py checks the CV name header against this.

years_experience.description: Total in-cluster years; drives CV length target and seniority judgments.

account.description: The ONLY mailbox the pipeline may read. The mail account guard verifies this before reading anything.

ats_min_score.description: Deterministic ATS score below which /prepare regenerates (max 2 iterations).

shortlist_depth_cap.description: Adaptive intake: above this many shortlisted+ready, /hunt raises the fit bar and halves target_count.

velocity_sla_days.description: Prepare-and-apply window for high-fit jobs before liveness must be re-verified.

ready_wip_cap.description: At or above this many `ready` rows, /cycle skips its prepare phase and reports the backlog. Generating assets faster than they are sent is what loses prepared work to closed postings.

prepare_per_cycle.description: Ceiling on new application folders per scheduled /cycle pass.

stale_pre_application_days.description: A shortlisted/generated/ready row older than this gets a /refresh liveness re-check before more work is spent on it.

extra_role_clusters.description: Cluster ids added on top of the pack's roles.yaml.

cycle.description: Scheduled profiles for /cycle. /optimise proposes calibrated values from what runs actually cost; the user approves.

default_intensity.description: Profile used when /cycle is invoked without --intensity.

intensities.description: Named profiles, e.g. daily and weekly.

hunt_target.description: Qualifying postings to collect in the hunt phase.

prepare_count.description: Application folders to generate, subject to ready_wip_cap.

time_budget_min.description: Wall-clock ceiling for the whole pass.

liveness_sweep.description: stale_only re-checks pre-application rows past stale_pre_application_days; all runs /refresh's full default selection.

location_fit_values.description: Allowed location_fit enum. Default: match, remote_ok, relocation_eu, relocation_non_eu, reject. db.py validates against this UNION values already in the DB.
